evidence.description: CRIT-001: the pure core implements the four outcome formulas, deterministic revision winners, closed envelopes, safe references, and no activity-counter input.
CRIT-001 and CRIT-002: fresh focused run passed 14/14 with zero fail, skipped, or todo tests; the endpoint test observed one exact authenticated snapshot RPC and exact fail-closed responses.
CRIT-002: the score path binds the session UID, sends only p_uid and four p_periods in one RPC, validates all four arrays, and maps unavailable, malformed, overflow, and period failures closed.

CRIT-004: the fresh deterministic score evaluation reported exactly 27/27; its aggregate-overflow variant uses two individually safe rows, and its MENTAL case covers absent, unparseable, before-occurred, exact-end, and after-end resolved_at values.

Independent direct-core probes confirmed per-row and individually-safe aggregate overflow return exact invalid_data, absent MENTAL resolved_at scores, and unparseable/before/exact-end/after-end values remain unresolved.
The import-banned oracle independently evaluates all 21 literal period/score groups and every declared variant without importing the production scorer, API, or UI.

CRIT-003: fresh real PostgreSQL execution passed roles=3, snapshot_sessions=2, complete_rows=20000, and overflow_rows=20001, including idempotency, conflict, append-only, tenant/period, privilege, statement-snapshot, and complete-or-overflow assertions.

CRIT-005: the executable renderer accepts the closed four-organ model and rejects contradictory measured ratios, duplicate references, missing components, malformed periods, invalid references, and missing organs.
The actual browser-injected validator linkage rejected a contradictory score response with invalid score payload and rendered the score section's closed loading-error copy.
CRIT-006: score derivation is an explicit deterministic pure boundary with supplied rows, periods, timezone, and clock values only.
The score API owns the sole source RPC, the UI validates and renders without recomputation, and the independent oracle contains no production scorer/API/UI import.
CRIT-007: fresh complete regression execution reported 447/447 passing with zero failures, skips, or todos; the included score suite reported 14/14.
CRIT-007: fresh evaluation reported calendar 21/21, late 12/12, context/onboarding/discovery 12/12, and score 27/27.
CRIT-008: validateChainCompleteness returned valid=true with no warnings; TEST-001 through TEST-016 are green and PROP-001 through PROP-006 are pending at the exact declared proof-harness paths.
